prompt.title: Collect what inspires you
prompt.chapterReference: Habit 2: Begin with the End in Mind
prompt.text: Keep the lines, thoughts and ideas that move you: something a friend said, a sentence you keep returning to, a way of living you'd like to try. You'll draw on them when you write your mission.
prompt.whyItMatters: A mission statement written cold sounds like a brochure. One built from lines you already love sounds like you. Collecting takes seconds; the payoff comes when you sit down to write.

list.empty: Nothing collected yet. What's one line you keep coming back to?
list.noMatch: Nothing matches your search or filters.

form.textPrompt: Write it the way you remember it.
form.textPlaceholder: e.g. Nobody on their deathbed wished they'd answered more email.
form.sourcePrompt: Who said it, or where were you?
form.sourcePlaceholder: e.g. My uncle, at his retirement dinner.
form.tagsPrompt: One or two words to find it later: work, family, courage.

guide.inShort: You'll save lines, thoughts and ideas as they come to you, with a tag or two. Thirty seconds each. When you write your mission, they'll be waiting beside the draft.
howTo: Tap "Add to collection" and write the line as you remember it.
Say what it is: something you heard, your own thought, or an idea to try.
Add where it's from. It'll mean more later.
Give it a tag or two, and star the ones that hit hardest.
Add one whenever something lands. Tap "Mark done" once you have three.

guide.afterwards: Read your favourites before each pass at your mission. Anything you've outgrown, delete; the collection should feel like you now, not you three years ago.
